12b

 

The light that arrives at Earth from Gacrux can be passed through a spectrometer/diffraction grating/prism and projected onto a screen to form an absorption spectrum.

The absorption spectrum is specific to elements, so it can be used to determine the composition of Gacrux.

12c(i)

 

Before becoming a red giant, Gacrux was a main sequence star.

12c(ii)

 

When Gacrux was a main sequence star, it was fusing hydrogen into helium.

12d

 

The outer shell of Gacrux will keep expanding and its surface temperature will rise.

As a result, Gacrux will explode in a planetary nebula.

Eventually, the remaining core will form a white dwarf.
